extracted.name: Maple Salad Dressing
extracted.description: Maple syrup lends its flavor and sweetness to this balsamic vinaigrette with basil and lemon juice.
instruction_lines: Blend maple syrup, balsamic vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, dry mustard, salt, basil, and black pepper in a blender until smooth; stream olive oil into the mixture while blending and continue blending until dressing is thick and creamy.
